info.title: DocKit - PDF Text Extraction & Markdown to PDF
info.description:
# DocKit: PDF Text Extraction and Markdown to PDF

Read PDFs and write PDFs over a simple REST API: get page counts and metadata, extract text page by page, and turn Markdown or plain text into clean A4 PDFs, returned as a file or base64.

**Who it's for:** developers automating invoices and reports, document-ingestion and RAG pipelines, no-code workflows (Zapier, Make, n8n) and back-office tools.

## Use cases
- Extract text from supplier PDFs for search, RAG or LLM summarisation.
- Check page counts before printing or charging per page.
- Generate invoices, receipts and reports from Markdown templates.
- Export chatbot or AI-written Markdown as a downloadable PDF.
- Archive form submissions as PDFs.

## Quickstart
Subscribe on RapidAPI (a free plan is available), copy your key, then:

```bash
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://dockit-pdf-text-extraction-markdown-to-pdf.p.rapidapi.com/pdf/info?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2FWAI%2FER%2Ftests%2Fxhtml%2Ftestfiles%2Fresources%2Fpdf%2Fdummy.pdf' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Key: YOUR_RAPIDAPI_KEY' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Host: dockit-pdf-text-extraction-markdown-to-pdf.p.rapidapi.com'
```

## Authentication
Every request goes through RapidAPI. Send `X-RapidAPI-Key` (your key) and `X-RapidAPI-Host` (`dockit-pdf-text-extraction-markdown-to-pdf.p.rapidapi.com`) on every call. Requests that bypass the gateway are rejected with `403`.

## Good to know
- PDF input is read from a public URL (max 10 MB, 15 s download timeout, redirects not followed).
- Text extraction needs a text layer; scanned PDFs need OCR first.
- Generated PDFs use the built-in Helvetica font, which covers Latin-1 characters only.
- Generation input limit is 200,000 characters.

## Rate limits and plans
Request quotas and per-second limits depend on the RapidAPI plan you subscribe to; see the Pricing tab. When a limit is reached the gateway returns `429 Too Many Requests`; retry with exponential backoff or move to a higher plan.

## Errors
All errors are JSON. The API returns `{"error": "<reason>"}` with a meaningful HTTP status: `400` disallowed URL (not http/https, or a private address), `413` input too large, `422` missing or invalid parameter, `502` upstream site or service failed. Gateway errors (`401`/`403`/`429`) come from RapidAPI as `{"message": "<reason>"}`.

## Data sources and licences
- PDF parsing with pypdf (BSD licence); PDF generation with fpdf2 (LGPL 3.0); Markdown conversion with Python-Markdown (BSD licence).

## MCP (AI agents)
This API is also available as a Model Context Protocol server at `POST /mcp` on the same RapidAPI host; see the MCP endpoint for setup.

get.summary: Get PDF metadata and page count
get.description: Downloads a PDF from a URL and returns its page count, encryption flag and document metadata (title, author, subject, creator, producer, dates) without extracting text.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Public URL that serves the PDF directly (http/https, max 10 MB). Redirects are not followed, so use the final URL. Private and reserved addresses are refused.

422.description: Missing URL, not a PDF, unreadable, or (for text) encrypted.

502.description: The PDF URL could not be fetched or did not return 200.

get.description: Downloads a PDF from a URL and extracts its text layer, returning the full text, per-page text, word count and metadata. Works on digitally created PDFs; scanned images without a text layer return empty text (no OCR).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Public URL that serves the PDF directly (http/https, max 10 MB). Redirects are not followed, so use the final URL. Private and reserved addresses are refused.

parameters.name: max_pages
parameters.description: Maximum pages to extract, from the first page (clamped to 1-200).

422.description: Missing URL, not a PDF, unreadable, or (for text) encrypted.

502.description: The PDF URL could not be fetched or did not return 200.

post.description: Renders Markdown (headings, bold/italic, lists, links, tables and fenced code) to an A4 PDF in Helvetica 11 pt with automatic page breaks. Ideal for invoices, reports, receipts and exporting AI-generated content. Characters outside Latin-1 (e.g. emoji, CJK) are replaced with `?`.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response type: omit (or any value other than `base64`) for the binary PDF; `base64` for JSON with a data URI.

title.description: Optional PDF metadata title (shown in viewer title bars; not printed on the page).

200.description: The generated A4 PDF (`Content-Disposition: inline; filename="document.pdf"`), or JSON when `format=base64`.

post.description: Lays out plain text on A4 pages in Helvetica 11 pt, wrapping long lines and preserving line breaks. Characters outside Latin-1 are replaced with `?`.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response type: omit (or any value other than `base64`) for the binary PDF; `base64` for JSON with a data URI.

title.description: Optional PDF metadata title (shown in viewer title bars; not printed on the page).

200.description: The generated A4 PDF (`Content-Disposition: inline; filename="document.pdf"`), or JSON when `format=base64`.

post.summary: MCP server (DocKit tools for AI agents)

Error.description: Error body. Errors raised by the API itself carry an `error` string. Errors raised by the RapidAPI gateway (missing or invalid key, not subscribed, quota or rate limit exceeded) carry a `message` string instead.

encrypted.description: PDF is encrypted (text extraction is refused for encrypted files).

creator.description: Application that created the original document.

created.description: Creation date as stored in the PDF (PDF date syntax, e.g. D:20070223175637+02'00').

modified.description: Modification date in PDF date syntax.

encrypted.description: PDF is encrypted (text extraction is refused for encrypted files).

creator.description: Application that created the original document.

created.description: Creation date as stored in the PDF (PDF date syntax, e.g. D:20070223175637+02'00').

modified.description: Modification date in PDF date syntax.

pages_extracted.description: Pages whose text was extracted (up to `max_pages`).

text.description: Text of all extracted pages, pages separated by blank lines.

page_texts.description: Text per extracted page, in order.

BadRequest.description: Bad request: the URL is not http(s), or points to a private, loopback or reserved address.

example.error: Private or reserved addresses are not allowed

Forbidden.description: Forbidden: the request did not arrive through the RapidAPI gateway, or your RapidAPI key is not subscribed to this API.

example.message: You are not subscribed to this API.

TooManyRequests.description: Too many requests: your RapidAPI plan's rate limit or monthly quota was exceeded. Back off and retry, or upgrade your plan.

example.message: You have exceeded the rate limit per second for your plan, BASIC, by the API provider
